title: Using cloudctl for grid rule R8
summary: R8 (Tom Dyer, 25 Nov 2026; UDP port amended to 62801): ed209k accepts XTP over UDP 62801 from cats2, and every ed209 machine accepts XTP (IP protocol 36 and UDP) from Tom's workstation 82.68.79.12; port 22 rules are never touched. Pattern: 1. read-only plan per node, ./cloudctl-rx.sh xtp NODE --add-only --workstation 82.68.79.12/32, outside the sandbox, reported with its NOTE and REMOVE lines (order D, REQ-00006241); 2. review: zero REMOVE, every CHANGE adds only grid or workstation sources; 3. apply per node only under an order marked NEEDS TOM'S DIRECT APPROVAL, where Codex asks Tom directly. ed209k is Vultr with scope=none: its ufw carries XTP (order B done). ed209f (Clouvider) and ed209h (Vultr cannot select protocol 36) need host firewall rules; ed209b was unreachable.
authority: architecture Tom Dyer; ooRexx Cloud Control coded by Claude (Opus 5.5), 7 Nov 2026; v0.2-dev3 fixes by Claude (Opus 5.5) at Tom Dyer's instruction ("fix cloud controller", 26 Nov 2026 10:50); v0.1-dev4 bash adapters by ChatGPT/Codex
invariants: Plans before apply; --add-only on every R8 run
No --apply without Tom Dyer's direct approval
Port 22 rules are never touched under R8
procedure: Order D: plans; then one apply order per node after review
